invite.title: Create account

forgot.title: Forgot password
forgot.intro: Enter your account email to get a reset link.
forgot.sent: If an account exists for this email, you'll receive a link in a few minutes. The link is valid for 30 minutes. Didn't get it? Check spam or ask the administrator for a link.

reset.title: Reset password
reset.invalid: This reset link isn't valid. It may have expired (it lasts 30 minutes) or already been used. Ask for a new link.
reset.done: Password reset. For security, all your sessions were ended, including this browser.
reset.review: Suspect unauthorized access? After signing in, review your Signal sources and NinjaTrader connections and revoke or unpair anything you don't recognize. Resetting the password does not disconnect NinjaTrader or invalidate alert URLs.

nav.signOutFailed: Could not sign out. Your session may still be active.

totp.title: Two-step verification
totp.recommended: Recommended: protects your trading accounts even if your password leaks.
totp.note: Turning this on or off signs you out on other devices.
totp.qrAlt: QR code for the authenticator app
totp.cannotScan: Can't scan it? Enter the key:
totp.wrongCode: Invalid code. Check that your phone's clock is correct and try again.
totp.disableBody: Your account will be protected by the password only, and your sessions on other devices will be ended.

recovery.warning: Keep these codes somewhere safe. Each works once. They won't be shown again.
recovery.replacedWarning: Keep these codes somewhere safe. Each works once. The previous codes no longer work.
recovery.guard: You haven't confirmed that you saved the codes. Close anyway?
recovery.regenerateBody: The previous codes stop working. Confirm with your password and current code.

session.keepAlive: Just leaving the page open doesn't keep the session active.

password.description: Your sessions on other devices will be ended.

banner.text: Protect your account with two-step verification.

link.guardBody: You haven't copied the link and it won't be shown again. Close anyway?

invites.title: Invitations
invites.emptyBody: Invite someone to use All Win.
invites.createBody: The invitation is valid for 7 days, is tied to one email and can be used once.
invites.manualDelivery: The email was not sent. Copy the link and send it yourself.
invites.emailFailed: Could not send the email. Copy the link and send it yourself. The invitation is still valid.

users.title: Users
users.linkBody: Valid for 30 minutes and works once. Send it over a channel where you confirmed the person's identity.
users.resetTotpBody: Use this only after confirming the person's identity over an independent channel (for example, a video call). The account will be protected by the password only, and their sessions will be ended.

sources.title: Signal sources
sources.description: Each source has a secret URL. Paste it into the alert's Webhook URL field in TradingView.

empty.title: No signal sources
empty.text: Create a source to receive TradingView alerts securely.

create.title: New source
create.description: Give it a name so you can recognize this source later.

rename.title: Rename source
rename.description: The name does not change the URL.

sources.unknownOutcome: We don't know whether the source was created. Refresh the list before trying again.

reveal.description: The URL is shown only once.
reveal.warning: Copy the URL now. For security, it won't be shown again. If you lose it, rotate to get a new one.
reveal.step1: In TradingView, open the alert → Notifications → Webhook URL.
reveal.automation: Orders from this source are automated. Accounts at firms that forbid automation only receive them if you accept that on the account.
reveal.guard: You haven't copied the URL yet. If you close now, you'll need to generate a new one. Close anyway?

rotate.title: Generate a new URL for “{name}”?
rotate.body: The current URL stops working immediately. Alerts that arrive with it are rejected and logged in the audit. Then paste the new URL into the TradingView alert.

revoke.title: Revoke source “{name}”?
revoke.body: Alerts using this URL will be rejected. The source stays in the history as revoked. This can't be undone; to receive signals again, create a new source.

pairing.title: Pair “{name}”
pairing.share: Enter this code in the NinjaTrader plugin.
pairing.instructions: In NinjaTrader: open the All Win window, click Pair and enter the code. Upper or lower case, with or without the hyphen.
pairing.superseded: A newer code was generated for this connection. This one is no longer valid.
pairing.locked: Pairing is temporarily locked after too many wrong attempts. Wait a few minutes and generate a new code.
pairing.paired: “{name}” connected. {count, plural, =0 {No accounts found.} one {# account found:} other {# accounts found:}}

move.title: Move “{name}” to another machine?
move.body: You'll get a new code. When it's used, the current instance is disconnected and stops receiving orders.

unpair.title: Unpair “{name}”?
unpair.body: This instance's plugin will be disconnected immediately and will stop receiving orders. To reconnect, create a new connection.
unpair.bound: These accounts will go out of sync and stop receiving orders: {accounts}.
unpair.openPositions: There is an open position in: {accounts}. The position stays open in NinjaTrader, with no All Win monitoring or risk protection. Nothing will be closed automatically.
unpair.acknowledge: I understand the position will stay open
